title: fix: keep recovering from rate limits after successful progress
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: long-running agent turns stop recovering from intermittent rate limits even when successful model responses occurred between failures. The final error can misleadingly show only a short provider retry hint.

## User Impact

Agent turns receive a fresh retry budget after a completed successful model response. Consecutive failures remain bounded, and terminal rate-limit errors explain actual automatic retry exhaustion. No new configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The failover controller resets the consecutive-outage retry count, backoff, and window only on completed model responses; partial streams and tool activity alone do not replenish them. The outer recovery guard follows the same progress signal. Existing per-attempt timeouts, caller deadlines, cancellation, output-limit continuation caps, and fallback routing remain intact.

Controller-recorded exhaustion now travels through error, payload, fallback, and final-reply paths without replacing raw provider diagnostics. Progressing turns can exceed a single attempt budget in aggregate; no competing whole-turn timer is introduced.

## Evidence

- Focused unit and boundary suites passed for retry recovery, fallback classification, prompt and assistant failures, provider error preservation, and terminal replies. Affected suites were rerun after the independent review fix.
- 21 focused lifecycle cases passed, including a 40-attempt progressing turn, bounded no-progress exhaustion, cancellation, and final error delivery.
- Core and owning test-graph typechecks, targeted lint, all 28 changed-file formatting checks, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent review identified loss of provider text when enriching an existing `FailoverError`; fixed and regression-tested.
- Initial PR CI exposed a PR import cycle (fixed with a type-only leaf import; Madge reports zero cycles) and inherited main database-type/wrapper-inventory failures. Integrated the verified main repairs; core typecheck, 25 terminal-reply tests, 25 user-copy tests, and 21 retry lifecycle cases passed on the integrated candidate. The lifecycle run selected 21 cases and skipped 126 unrelated cases.
- Exact-head [CI run38517286225, attempt1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38517286225) completed all84jobs. The only failed root is `checks-ui-e2e (6/7)`: `keeps stale context visible as approximate without warning` still expects the removed `Context` label. Main commit `d51fa95da4e0` intentionally made the context ring icon-only; this PR changes none of the UI tree or its dependencies. The dependent CI aggregate also failed; `security-fast` passed. Landing uses the native inherited-only CI exception, not a claim that CI is green. The original UI owner is repairing the stale assertion separately.
- No live provider exercise, deployment, restart, or live configuration change was performed by this task.
